# Royal Equipments

> Royal Equipments is a commercial kitchen equipment manufacturer and dealer based in New Delhi, India, with 25+ years of experience. It designs, manufactures and supplies stainless steel kitchen, bakery, refrigeration, bar, display and exhaust equipment for hotels, restaurants, bakeries, sweet shops, cloud kitchens, canteens and hospitals across Delhi NCR (including Gurgaon, Noida and Haryana).

- Address: Plot No. A1, Suraj Vihar, Opposite NSIT College, Near Dwarka Mor Metro Station, New Delhi – 110078, India
- Phone: +91 9310010882, +91 9811810882, +91 9355055513
- Email: sales@royalequipments.in, royalequipments@gmail.com

## Products

- [All Products](https://www.royalequipments.in/our-products/): Full product catalogue
- [Preparation Equipments](https://www.royalequipments.in/preparation-equipments/): Wet grinders, pulverizers, vegetable cutters, potato peelers, commercial mixers
- [Cooking Equipments](https://www.royalequipments.in/cooking-equipments/): Single to four burner ranges, Chinese burner ranges, romali roti machines
- [Chapati Equipments](https://www.royalequipments.in/chapati-equipments/): Automatic and semi-automatic chapati machines, puffers, dough kneaders
- [Refrigeration](https://www.royalequipments.in/refrigeration/): Reach-in and under-counter refrigerators and freezers
- [Water Cooler & Dispensers](https://www.royalequipments.in/water-cooler-manufacturer/): Stainless steel water coolers and dispensers
- [Bar Equipments](https://www.royalequipments.in/bar-equipments/): Back bar chillers, cocktail and blender stations, glass storage, wine chillers
- [Cake & Pastry Display Counters](https://www.royalequipments.in/cake-pastry-display-counter-manufacturers/): Curved, rectangular and vertical display counters
- [Stainless Steel Tables](https://www.royalequipments.in/stainless-steel-table/): Work tables with shelves, cabinets and granite tops
- [Storage Equipments](https://www.royalequipments.in/storage-equipments/): Storage racks, bins and wall-mounted cabinets
- [Trolley Equipments](https://www.royalequipments.in/trolley-equipments/): Service, food, tea/snacks and room service trolleys
- [Service Equipments](https://www.royalequipments.in/service-equipments/): Bain maries, hot case counters, plate warmers, soup kettles
- [Bakery Equipments](https://www.royalequipments.in/bakery-equipments-manufacturer/): Single, double and triple deck ovens, conveyor ovens, proofers
- [Imported Equipments](https://www.royalequipments.in/imported-equipments/): Coffee machines, softy machines, ice cube machines, sandwich grillers
- [Washing Equipments](https://www.royalequipments.in/dishwasher-dealer-in-delhi/): Dishwashers, sinks, pot racks and dish landing tables
- [Exhaust, Fresh Air & Gas Pipeline](https://www.royalequipments.in/exhaust-fresh-air-gas-pipe-line-ducting-system/): Exhaust hoods, air curtains, blowers, GI ducting
